_title: The controls the EMC PRMT5 manuscript stated and had not run.
_source: research/modalities/emc-expression-panels.json — every z is lifted from it; nothing new is measured here, only cut differently and tested differently.
_no_clinical_claim: ⛔ Nothing here asserts efficacy, safety, a therapeutic window or clinical readiness for any agent in any disease.
⚠_these_are_controls_not_further_hypothe: They were specified before they were run, each against a named weakness in the manuscript. Reading a control's result as a new finding would be a multiplicity problem wearing a control's clothes.
⛔_the_chondroid_control_is_the_weak_one_: No comparator in either series is cartilage-lineage, so it can only ask whether PRMT5 and chondroid markers move together within these samples. 'Chondroid tumours express PRMT5' is NOT excluded by anything in this file.

exact_permutation_PRMT5._status: EXACT — every labeling enumerated, no approximation and no random sampling
exact_permutation_PRMT5.⚠_what_this_p_is_not: It is exact for the LABELLING only. It corrects nothing for the number of genes examined, and the manuscript's 'uncorrected for multiple testing' limit stands unchanged. The genome-wide placement below is the field that speaks to that, and it is a different quantity.

PRMT9._meaning: ⛔ the read could not be taken on this platform — an instrument statement, never evidence the gene is not expressed

prmt_family_specificity.reading: ⭐ PRMT5 is the highest-scoring readable PRMT on this platform — the elevation is not simply family-wide.
prmt_family_specificity.⛔_what_this_cannot_settle: Abundance, not activity. Every PRMT here is a transcript level; none of them says an enzyme is working, and a family member with no probe is simply unread.

proliferation_control.⚠_coverage: 12 of 12 requested genes readable — a score built on few genes is a weak instrument and a null from it is weak evidence.
proliferation_control.reading: ✅ THE CONTRAST SURVIVES the adjustment — it retains its sign and most of its magnitude, so this axis does not account for it.
proliferation_control.⛔_what_this_cannot_settle: A transcript score is a proxy. Adjusting for it removes the part of the contrast that is LINEARLY predicted by that proxy and nothing more; a confound the proxy measures badly survives adjustment untouched. And with n this small the adjustment itself is unstable.

chondroid_lineage_control.⚠_coverage: 8 of 8 requested genes readable — a score built on few genes is a weak instrument and a null from it is weak evidence.
chondroid_lineage_control.reading: ✅ THE CONTRAST SURVIVES the adjustment — it retains its sign and most of its magnitude, so this axis does not account for it.
chondroid_lineage_control.⛔_what_this_cannot_settle: A transcript score is a proxy. Adjusting for it removes the part of the contrast that is LINEARLY predicted by that proxy and nothing more; a confound the proxy measures badly survives adjustment untouched. self_check._what: the null's t vs the panel's committed t, for every wanted gene both paths scored on this platform

genome_wide_placement.⭐_how_to_read_it: `frac_of_array_at_least_as_extreme_two_sided` is the fraction of all symbols on this array whose EMC-vs-comparator |t| is at least this gene's. NR4A3 and ENO3 are included as the instrument's positive controls: the disease-defining transcript and a published direct target should sit far out, and if they do not, no other row on this list means anything.
genome_wide_placement.⛔_not_a_correction: This controls no error rate. It answers 'is this t remarkable on this array', which is the question the phrase 'uncorrected for multiple testing' leaves open — not the same as correcting for it.
